newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: - Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings fairly light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 70.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075 lbs ld 70.75.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared to Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady, instances $1.00 higher in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 112.00-113.00 few west 114.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 102.00-103.00 Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs couple lds 103.00-104.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 100.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 113.00 few west 114.00.
Wk to Date - 6,500 Week Ago - 22,400 Year Ago - 20,800
